experiments.title: PCr Recovery Kinetics, Acidosis Coupling and Asymptote Sensitivity

acidosis_regression.finding: Lower post-load pH is strongly correlated with slower PCr recovery (tau increases ~140 s/pH unit drop).

asymptote_sensitivity.finding: A +/-5% error in resting asymptote introduces a -17.8% to +26.4% distortion in estimated tau.

fiber_heterogeneity_mono_bias.finding: Forcing a mono-exponential model on heterogeneous muscle creates systematic early-recovery bias up to 11.4%.

experiments.title: Pulmonary Oxygen Kinetics, Transport Delay and Inseparability
experiments.finding: Circulatory transit delay and muscle oxidative time constant exhibit strong collinearity (correlation r=-0.704); pulmonary on-transients cannot separate them without independent venous timing.

experiments.title: Local-Systemic Coupling and Excess CO2 Bicarbonate Buffering

pcr_vo2_coupling.finding: Statistically significant positive coupling between local PCr resynthesis and pulmonary VO2 recovery off-transient.

excess_co2_acidosis_coupling.finding: Significant inverse correlation between end-exercise muscle pH and expired excess non-metabolic CO2.

systemic_parasitic_partition.finding: Local muscle work accounts for only 33.7% of delta systemic oxygen expenditure; 66.3% is dissipated in cardiorespiratory and postural stabilization.

experiments.title: Absolute Metabolic Energy Scale and Active Volume Uncertainty
experiments.finding: Uncertainty in muscle volume and biochemical references produces a 4.99-fold ambiguity in absolute energy and derived efficiency (eta spanning 3.96 to 19.78), confirming Symmetry 1 cannot be eliminated without volumetric MRI.

experiments.title: Mechanical Power Prediction and Observational Bridge Boundaries
experiments.finding: Calibrated local bridge achieves RMSE=0.65 W vs constant RMSE=3.15 W, but only when depletion magnitude is known post hoc. The model remains a diagnostic bridge, not an autonomous forward predictor of voluntary exhaustion.
